subtitles.speaker: Woman
subtitles.en: I have heard that Motonari is a black-hearted schemer. Please, do not let your guard down.

subtitles.speaker: Yamanaka Shikanosuke
subtitles.en: Have no fear. No scheme can kill me.

subtitles.speaker: Yamanaka Shikanosuke
subtitles.en: Besides, I have Norimitsu, the sword my father left me.

subtitles.speaker: Woman
subtitles.en: Will that sword ever be drawn?

subtitles.speaker: Yamanaka Shikanosuke
subtitles.en: When the time comes, perhaps it will.

subtitles.speaker: Yamanaka Shikanosuke
subtitles.en: I must go. The hour is near.

subtitles.speaker: Yamanaka Shikanosuke
subtitles.en: I pray you, grant me seven hardships and eight trials!
